items.html: Now, after the third head, the upper bone is sealed with the membrane of the air, and the light descends through the hairs, like the light of the sun that passes through small holes. And this is for Aba, for in Aba alone the upper bone spreads without a garment, because it is included in the Mazal and is considered like Atik; but ZA was made through Aba, for the bone spread and clothed in him, and through it three brains were made in him.
